description: This file implements the RLC Transmission Entity for Acknowledged Mode (AM) in a 5G NR protocol stack, handling SDU processing, PDU building, retransmissions, status report handling, and buffer management.

classes.name: rlc_tx_am_entity
classes.description: Represents the RLC Transmission Entity in Acknowledged Mode, managing SDUs, PDUs, retransmissions, and status reports.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming SDU, assigns PDCP SN, and queues it for transmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU with a specific PDCP SN from the queue.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Builds and retrieves the next PDU for transmission, handling status PDUs, retransmissions, and new SDUs.

methods.name: build_new_pdu
methods.description: Constructs a new data PDU from queued SDUs, segmenting if necessary.

methods.name: build_first_sdu_segment
methods.description: Creates the first segment of an SDU that needs segmentation.

methods.name: build_continued_sdu_segment
methods.description: Creates a continued segment of an SDU under segmentation.

methods.name: build_retx_pdu
methods.description: Constructs a retransmission PDU for a specific SN.

methods.name: on_status_pdu
methods.description: Handles an incoming status report, delegating to executor.

methods.name: handle_status_pdu
methods.description: Processes a status report, updating ACK/NACKs, retransmissions, and window state.

methods.name: on_status_report_changed
methods.description: Triggers buffer state update when status report changes.

methods.name: handle_nack
methods.description: Processes a NACK, scheduling retransmission of the specified SDU segment.

methods.name: increment_retx_count
methods.description: Increments the retransmission count for a given SN.

methods.name: decrement_retx_count
methods.description: Decrements the retransmission count for a given SN.

methods.name: check_sn_reached_max_retx
methods.description: Checks if SN has reached maximum retransmission threshold and notifies upper layer.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Triggers update of MAC buffer state if needed.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Sends current buffer state to lower layer, with optional force notification.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Calculates and returns current buffer occupancy and state.

methods.name: get_polling_bit
methods.description: Determines whether to set the poll bit in a PDU based on criteria.

methods.name: on_expired_poll_retransmit_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the poll retransmission timer, scheduling retransmission if needed.

methods.name: inside_tx_window
methods.description: Checks if a SN is within the current transmission window.

methods.name: is_tx_window_full
methods.description: Checks if the transmission window is full.

methods.name: valid_ack_sn
methods.description: Validates if an ACK SN is within the acceptable range.

methods.name: valid_nack
methods.description: Validates if a NACK is within the acceptable range and window.
